title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
At ProArch, we partner with businesses around the world to turn big ideas into better outcomes through IT services that span cybersecurity, cloud, data, AI, and app development. We’re 400+ team members strong across 3 countries (we call ourselves ProArchians)—and here’s what connects us all:

* A love for solving real business problems
* A belief in doing what’s right

**What’s it like to work here?**

* You’ll keep growing. You’ll work alongside domain experts who love to share what they know.
* You’ll be supported, heard, and trusted to make an impact.
* You’ll take on projects that touch industries, communities, and lives.
* You’ll have the time to focus on what matters most in your life outside of work.

At ProArch, you’ll be part of teams that design and deliver technology solutions solving real business challenges for our clients. With services spanning AI, Data, Application Development, Cybersecurity, Cloud & Infrastructure, and Industry Solutions, your work may involve building intelligent applications, securing business‑critical systems, or supporting cloud migrations and infrastructure modernization.

Every role here contributes to shaping outcomes for global clients and driving meaningful impact. You’ll collaborate with experts across data, AI, engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, and infrastructure—solving complex problems with creativity, precision, and purpose. You’ll join a culture rooted in technology, curiosity, and continuous learning. A place where we move fast, trust you to make an impact, encourage innovation, and support your growth.

**Job Summary:**

ProArch is seeking a **Azure Data Engineer** with **5–8 years of experience** to join our Data & Analytics practice. In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize scalable cloud-based data solutions that support enterprise analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives. You will work with large-scale datasets using **Azure Data Platform technologies**, build high-performance data pipelines, and collaborate directly with business and client stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable data solutions.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in **SQL, Python, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake**, and **Microsoft Fabric**, along with solid experience in **data modelling**, DataOps, and client-facing engagements.

**Responsibilities:**

* Build and orchestrate data ingestion workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, including databases, APIs, enterprise applications, and cloud storage. Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and Microsoft Fabric.
* Develop and optimize data transformation workflows using Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Python, and SQL.
* Implement and support Microsoft Fabric data engineering solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, lakehouse development, and migration of legacy data pipelines.
* Design and implement modern data lakehouse architectures using Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Delta Lake, and Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers).
* Develop data models, including fact and dimension tables, to support analytical reporting and enterprise data warehousing.
* Optimize SQL queries, data models, and pipeline execution for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Implement data quality checks, validation rules, error handling, and monitoring to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and reliability.
* Apply data governance, metadata management, and data lineage practices using appropriate Azure and Microsoft data governance tools.
* Implement version control, automated deployments, and CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data architects, BI developers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust data solutions.
* Troubleshoot production data issues, improve pipeline reliability, and maintain technical documentation.
* Contribute to cloud data modernization initiatives, including migration of existing ETL workloads to Azure and Microsoft Fabric.

 **Requirements**

**1. Azure Data Factory (ADF)**

* Strong hands-on experience developing and managing ADF pipelines.
* Experience with data ingestion, pipeline orchestration, scheduling, parameterization, and reusable pipeline frameworks.
* Ability to implement data integration, transformation workflows, error handling, and monitoring.

**2. Microsoft Fabric**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric data engineering capabilities.
* Experience developing data pipelines and working with Fabric Lakehouse and related data processing capabilities.
* Understanding of data ingestion, transformation, Delta-based storage, and end-to-end data engineering workflows.
* Experience migrating or modernizing existing data pipelines on Microsoft Fabric is desirable.

**3. Azure Databricks and PySpark**

* Experience developing scalable data processing solutions using Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, and Python.
* Knowledge of distributed data processing, data transformations, and performance optimization.
* Experience implementing Medallion Architecture and working with Delta Lake.

**4. SQL and Data Warehousing**

* Strong SQL skills, including complex queries, joins, aggregations, stored procedures, and query optimization.
* Experience with relational databases such as Azure SQL, SQL Server, or Azure Synapse Analytics.
* Knowledge of dimensional modeling, fact and dimension tables, and analytical data warehouse design.

**5. Azure Data Storage and Integration**

* Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2).
* Understanding of structured and semi-structured data formats, including Parquet and Delta.
* Experience integrating data from databases, APIs, files, and enterprise applications.

**6. Data Quality, Governance, and DevOps**

* Experience implementing data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks.
* Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and data lineage.
* Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD automation using GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with Microsoft Purview and data governance frameworks.
* Exposure to Power BI and analytical reporting requirements.
* Experience with Snowflake or other cloud data platforms.
* Familiarity with AWS data services or cross-cloud data migration.
* Understanding of GDPR and data privacy requirements.
* Experience in healthcare, retail, or other enterprise data environments.
* Knowledge of reusable ETL frameworks, automated testing, and production support practices.

title: IT Network Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and responsible IT Network Engineer to manage, maintain, and troubleshoot the hospital's IT infrastructure, network systems, servers, and connectivity. The candidate will ensure smooth and uninterrupted operation of IT services supporting hospital departments, clinical systems, and administrative operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, monitor, and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, and firewalls.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity issues, hardware failures, and internet-related problems.
* Maintain and support desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT peripherals.
* Provide technical support for hospital information systems (HIS/HMS), billing, laboratory, radiology, and other departmental applications.
* Monitor network performance and ensure reliable connectivity across all hospital departments.
* Manage user accounts, access permissions, antivirus, system updates, and basic IT security.
* Maintain network documentation, IT asset registers, and preventive maintenance records.
* Coordinate with internet service providers, software vendors, and hardware support teams.
* Support CCTV, biometric attendance systems, IP phones, and other network-connected devices, as assigned.
* Ensure regular data backup coordination and follow hospital data confidentiality and security policies.
* Respond promptly to IT-related complaints and resolve technical issues within the required time.
* Provide technical support to doctors, nurses, billing, front office, and administrative staff.

Educational Qualifications

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; or
* Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Computer Applications, Computer Science, or Networking.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and Wi-Fi.
* Hands-on experience with routers, switches, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of Windows operating systems, printers, and desktop support.
* Basic understanding of servers, backups, cybersecurity, and network monitoring.
* Good troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to support hospital operations with minimal downtime.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience in a hospital or healthcare organization.
* Knowledge of HIS/HMS, PACS/RIS, laboratory systems, and medical IT infrastructure.
* CCNA, CompTIA Network+, or other relevant networking certifications.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Network uptime and connectivity reliability.
* Timely resolution of IT support tickets.
* Preventive maintenance completion.
* Reduction in recurring technical issues.
* Timely updating of IT asset and network documentation.
* Compliance with hospital IT security and data confidentiality policies.

General Requirements

The candidate must be willing to provide timely technical support to all hospital departments and ensure the smooth functioning of IT infrastructure in a patient-care environment.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Development Operations Engineer
description:
### **Description**

Infor are recruiting a **Development Operations Engineer** who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, automation, and operational excellence. This role is central to ensuring the continuous delivery and stability of Infor's cutting-edge cloud-based enterprise software, including our large-scale ERP SaaS solutions. The ideal candidate has a track record of automating zero-downtime deployments for enterprise-scale software and is equally comfortable operating in AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform alongside our in-house automation tooling.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support seamless, zero-downtime delivery of enterprise-scale applications such as ERP SaaS solutions.
* Build and extend in-house automation tooling to streamline deployments, operational tasks, and developer workflows.
* Collaborate with cross-functional product teams to support build, test, and deployment automation.
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and proactively optimize infrastructure across AWS and Kubernetes environments.
* Develop infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform (and AWS CloudFormation where applicable) to provision and manage cloud resources.
* Administer and tune Linux and Windows Server systems supporting production and non-production environments.
* Contribute to the standardization and automation of development workflows and operational tasks using Python, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Support application scalability, security, and resilience in alignment with Infor's cloud-first strategy.
* Participate in on-call rotations and incident response to ensure high availability of services.
* Document processes, procedures, and solutions to ensure knowledge sharing and maintainability.

* **5-7 Years experience in DevOps**, SRE, or related engineering role supporting large enterprise-scale software, ideally ERP or other SaaS solutions.

* Experience with **CI/CD tools** such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, plus building or maintaining in-house automation tooling.

title: Software Engineering - Technical Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

As a Software Engineering Technical Specialist, you will develop solutions in specific domains such as Security, Systems, Databases, Networking Solutions, and more. You will be a leader – contributing knowledge, guidance, technical expertise, and team leadership skills. Your leadership will be demonstrated in your work, to your customers, and within your teams.

  

**What you will do**

* Demonstrate strong communication and collaboration skills across cross-functional teams.
* Identify opportunities for business transformation and recommend technology-driven improvements.
* Communicate complex technical and business concepts effectively to customers and stakeholders.
* Serve as a trusted advisor for resolving customer business and technical challenges.
* Analyze, define, and solve complex problems through structured decision-making.
* Collect, evaluate, and integrate information from multiple sources to support timely business decisions.
* Improve service effectiveness, operational efficiency, and delivery through technology and best-practice methodologies.
* Design, develop, integrate, and deliver highly scalable distributed software solutions.
* Drive the continuous evolution and enhancement of software products and platforms.
* Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, and partner teams.
* Develop solutions and functionality that address customer and business requirements.
* Participate in and support the Agile software development lifecycle.
* Groom and refine features and user stories to ensure delivery readiness.
* Estimate effort, identify technical risks, and manage project dependencies.
* Communicate risks, dependencies, and technical considerations to project stakeholders.
* Ensure high-quality feature delivery within established timelines.
* Drive the remediation of technical debt and security vulnerabilities.
* Maintain and upgrade third-party components to ensure product stability, security, and compliance.
* Mentor and coach engineers on software development best practices.
* Guide teams in designing and implementing secure, scalable, and highly available distributed systems.
* Promote engineering excellence through technical leadership and knowledge sharing.
Contribute to the innovation, growth, and success of software products and solutions.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

• Lead functional design and implementation of Oracle EPM Cloud solutions supporting Fleet Procurement and Fleet Accounting processes.

• 15+ years of overall experience in financial systems with 7+ years of hands-on Oracle EPM Cloud experience

• Configure and support FCCS and EPBCS to enable fleet financial consolidation, planning, forecasting, and management reporting.

• Partner with Fleet Accounting, Finance, and FP&A teams to define future-state planning and consolidation models aligned with Oracle Fusion Financials.

• Design and implement integration flows between Oracle Fusion ERP (GL, FAH, AP, AR) and Oracle EPM Cloud using standard adapters, data management, and integration tools.

• Define metadata structures including dimensions, hierarchies, account mappings, cost centers, intercompany, and fleet-specific reporting attribute

• Support design of fleet cost allocation models, capitalization tracking, depreciation analysis, and financial performance reporting in EPM.

• Lead data validation, reconciliation, and variance analysis between Oracle Fusion ERP and Oracle EPM Cloud.

• Collaborate with Data Migration and Technical teams to support initial loads, incremental data refreshes, and reconciliation processes.

• Support SIT, UAT, and parallel close activities to validate EPM outputs against ERP financial results.

• Develop and validate EPM reports, dashboards, Smart View templates, and management reporting artifacts.

• Support planning cycles including budget, forecast, and scenario modeling related to fleet procurement, utilization, and lifecycle costs.

• Provide functional guidance during cutover, deployment, and post-go-live hypercare for EPM components.

• Work closely with PMO, Solution Architects, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment between EPM design and overall program objectives.

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or related field.

• Strong functional expertise in FCCS and EPBCS, including consolidation, planning, forecasting, and financial reporting.

• Solid understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials including GL, FAH, AP, AR, and how ERP data feeds EPM.Oracle EPM Functional Consultant

• Experience designing EPM solutions for large-scale ERP transformation programs with multi-region deployments.

• Strong knowledge of financial close, consolidation, intercompany eliminations, and management reporting.

• Experience integrating Oracle EPM Cloud with Oracle Fusion ERP using standard integration frameworks.

• Hands-on experience with Smart View, EPM reporting, and data reconciliation techniques.

• Strong analytical skills with ability to translate fleet-related financial data into actionable insights.

• Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.Oracle Financial Consolidation and Close Cloud (FCCS)Implementation Certification, Oracle Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud(EPBCS) Implementation Certification, Oracle EPM Cloud Data Management Certification

  
  
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Member Technical
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**DevOps Senior member Technical -** **Role Overview**

Supports the design and maintenance of enterprise systems by preparing test data, analyzing results, troubleshooting problems and communicating issues back to development. The DevOps approach to software development requires frequent, incremental changes to code versions, resulting in frequent deployment and testing regimens. Develops, monitors and maintain procedures and service level needs while providing user support. Automation engineers design, program, simulate and test automated machinery and processes in order to complete exact tasks.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, monitor, and maintain CI/CD pipelines and supporting infrastructure.
* Support enterprise systems by preparing and executing test scenarios, analyzing outcomes, and identifying areas for improvement.
* Collaborate with development teams to implement DevOps best practices and streamline software delivery processes.
* Automate operational and deployment tasks using scripting and automation tools.
* Manage and support CI/CD platforms, source control repositories, and artifact management systems.
* Monitor system health, availability, and performance of DevOps tools and services.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and automation workflows.
* Maintain operational procedures, service-level requirements, and technical documentation.
* Provide end-user and application support as required.
* Design, program, simulate, test, and optimize automated processes to improve operational efficiency and reliability.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 6 years of experience working with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as **Jenkins, GitLab, Chef, and Artifactory**.
* Strong proficiency in scripting and automation using **Bash, Python, and Groovy**.
* Hands-on experience implementing and maintaining **Continuous Integration (CI)** and **Continuous Deployment (CD)** solutions following industry best practices.
* Experience with **Git-based version control systems** and artifact repository management.

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. **Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

* Lead business process discovery workshops for Procure-to-Pay business process, covering requisition-to-purchase order, supplier enablement, and invoice-to-pay processes.

. Experience: 15+ years overall Oracle ERP experience, with at least 5+ years in Oracle Fusion Procurement Cloud (PO, AP, SSP, Approvals)

* Work closely with the Change Management and Training team to ensure that process changes are documented and communicated effectively.

* Contribute to project deliverables, including scope definition, assumptions, and effort estimates for implementation planning.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Supply Chain, or Engineering (or equivalent).

* Hands-on experience with Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes, including purchase order lifecycle, supplier invoice matching, and payment accounting.

* Proven ability to lead workshops, define requirements, and document fit-gap analysis and configuration workbooks.

* Exposure to Capital Procurement processes, including asset capitalization and financing flows.

* Familiarity with Oracle EPM (EPBCS) planning integration for procurement budgeting and spend reconciliation.

* Strong documentation and communication skills — capable of translating business requirements into Oracle Cloud functional design.

* Experience in multi-region rollouts and collaboration with offshore/onshore delivery teams.

* Oracle Cloud Procurement certification (preferred).

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Job Description:

Our Release Engineering team is looking for an Engineer whose primary focus is administering and maintaining our Jira Data Center and Jira Cloud environments, including driving the ongoing migration from Data Center to Cloud. **Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience
* 2+ years of experience in systems administration, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and/or development, required
* Strong hands-on experience with Jira Data Center and Jira Cloud administration
* Proven experience with the ScriptRunner plugin (Groovy scripting)
* Experience performing Jira upgrades on Linux environments
* Solid understanding of Jira architecture: clustering, database (PostgreSQL/Oracle), indexing, and performance tuning
* Ability to troubleshoot application, plugin, and infrastructure issues
* Experience with a programming/scripting language such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, Java, C#, Ruby, etc.
* Knowledge of source code control tools such as Git (GitLab, GitHub, BitBucket)
* Experience in Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux / RHEL) and/or Windows operating system

**Preferred Knowledge and Experience**

* Experience or working knowledge of Jira Cloud migration (JCMA, Atlassian Cloud Migration tools) – a strong plus, as we are currently in a migration phase
* Familiarity with REST APIs, shell scripting, and Python
* Atlassian certifications (ACP)
* Familiarity in cloud computing, storage, and hosting functionality
* Experience with monitoring, alerting and incident response tools, and performing root cause analysis
* Familiarity with Agile best practices
* Excellent analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills

title: Senior Engineer, Virtualization
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***

**AHEAD is searching for a Senior Virtualization Engineer to be a part of our Managed Services team.** Candidates will be primarily responsible for the overall health, stability, security, performance, and lifecycle management of virtualization and compute platforms in our managed services customer environments. Candidates will serve as a senior member of the Managed Services Virtualization team, providing tier 3 technical leadership for virtualization technologies, complex incidents, platform improvements, and customer outcomes. The role participates in 24x7 operations and an on-call rotation. The ideal candidate should be customer focused, an effective communicator, self-initiating, accountable, and able to perform most tasks without direct oversight.

### **Principle Duties and Responsibilities**

Provide enterprise-level operational support for incident, problem, change, request, and event-management activities  

Lead complex and escalated virtualization incidents, including high-risk, recurring, cross-domain, vendor-dependent, and platform-impacting issues  
* Provide technical leadership during P1 incidents by assessing impact, coordinating technical actions, documenting risks and decisions, and driving resolution through closure

* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for virtualization and compute technologies, addressing technical events and requests needing additional resources or urgent attention

Assess customer environments for performance, capacity, configuration, design, resilience, security, and supportability issues; propose and implement resolutions  

* Provide architectural oversight and validate that proposed changes, designs, and remediation plans align with vendor-supported practices, client standards, capacity, resiliency, security, and service scope

* Work across networking, storage, operating-system, security, monitoring, automation, and application teams to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues

Work with vendors and hardware partners to resolve virtualization and compute issues, coordinate escalations, and implement supported resolutions  

* Own or contribute to problem-management records, corrective actions, preventive actions, post-incident reviews, and technical root-cause analyses for recurring or systemic issues

Lead or support platform lifecycle activities, including upgrade readiness, compatibility validation, capacity planning, end-of-support and end-of-life assessments, patch planning, firmware coordination, and VCF lifecycle management  

Maintain accurate client architecture, access, configuration, monitoring, hardware, firmware, inventory, and maintenance documentation. Reconcile documentation against authoritative platform, CMDB, monitoring, and inventory sources  
* Ensure that clients' infrastructure is healthy, stable, secure, documented, and configured with accepted technical best practices

Perform recurring operational-risk reviews and identify opportunities to improve platform stability, supportability, monitoring coverage, security posture, automation, and service consistency  

Support annual architecture, capacity, lifecycle, and standard-operating-procedure reviews, and provide technical inputs for quarterly business reviews or other strategic client reviews  
Own the technical execution of assigned client onboarding and offboarding activities, including access validation, monitoring coverage, vendor access, initial documentation, known-issue identification, and EoS/EoL review  
* Provide clear technical context, risk, impact, dependencies, recommended actions, and next steps to Client Success Managers and customer technical contacts. Business-impacting or scope-related customer communications should be coordinated through the appropriate Client Success Manager

* Participate in 24x7 operations and the on-call rotation, including major incidents and planned maintenance activities as scheduled

Complete training and certification as assigned to further skills and knowledge  

* Mentor L2 engineers, improve escalation quality, review technical work when assigned, and contribute to standards, runbooks, knowledge articles, training, and continuous-improvement initiatives

### **Qualifications/ Technology Experience**

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Unique education, specialized experience, skills, knowledge, training, or certification may be substituted)  

* 10+ yrs of experience with virtualization technologies and enterprise infrastructure operations
* + Experience with VMware vSphere/VVF required
  + Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) required
  + Experience with Nutanix AHV required
  + Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V preferred
  Experience with Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization, including virtual-machine lifecycle management, networking, storage integration, and operational troubleshooting
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) deployment, configuration, lifecycle management, and operational support
* + Proficiency in VCF lifecycle management, including automated deployment, patching, and upgrades using SDDC Manager
  + Experience with VCF workload domains, including VI workload domains and NSX-T network virtualization
  + Knowledge of VCF validated designs and reference architectures for hybrid-cloud implementations
  + Experience with VCF integration with public-cloud services (VMware Cloud on AWS, Azure VMware Solution, Google Cloud VMware Engine) preferred
  + Experience with VCF's automated deployment and configuration of vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and vRealize Suite or Aria components
  Demonstrated ability to manage converged infrastructure through VCF's unified platform spanning compute, storage, networking, and security
10+ yrs of experience with operational administration of enterprise IT systems  
10+ yrs of experience with performance and infrastructure monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, Elastic, or comparable platforms)  
5+ yrs of experience with an enterprise ITSM system. ServiceNow preferred  
* Experience with Cisco UCS and Dell hardware systems required
Familiarity with Dell PowerFlex/PowerStore/VxRail preferred  
* Operating System skills with Windows and Linux preferred
Understanding of PowerShell and PowerCLI with ability to create and utilize scripts for administration, troubleshooting, reporting, and automation required  
Managed Services or consulting experience required  
VMware Certified Professional certification required; VMware Certified Advanced Professional certification preferred  
* ITILv4 certification preferred

### **Qualifications: Soft Skills**

Advanced technical troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities  

* Approach projects, changes, and problems with a “security first” mindset

Superior customer service and training skills  

* Possess a strong sense of urgency and ability to set priorities during normal operations and high-impact events

Ability to work without direct supervision and make sound technical decisions  

Team-oriented collaborator willing to share knowledge and experience  
Ability to communicate technical risk, business impact, dependencies, decisions, and recommended actions clearly to engineers, managers, CSMs, vendors, and customer technical stakeholders  
Ability to remain accountable for coordination and follow-through until the next owner formally accepts an escalation  
* Ability to balance customer requests with platform capacity, resiliency, security, contractual scope, change control, and operational risk

Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills and ability to build and maintain collaborative and positive working relationships at all levels  

Ability to effectively interact with all levels of business via phone, written communication, and in person  
Skilled in achieving results in a customer centric environment  
* Self-motivated, able to work in a fast-paced 24x7 managed-services environment

**Why AHEAD:**

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

**India Employment Benefits include:**

**Comprehensive health insurance** coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents

**Paid time off and company holidays**, along with additional leave benefits as per policy

**Flexible work arrangements**, supporting work-life balance

**Learning and development opportunities** to support continuous growth and upskilling

**Employee wellness initiatives** and programs focused on physical and mental well-being

**Retirement and statutory benefits** in line with India regulations

**Inclusive and people-first culture**, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Software Development Engineer I
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you a software engineer who is excited about writing clean, well-tested code that ships to production and impacts millions of customers? At Amazon, you will have the opportunity to build software that operates at massive scale while growing your technical skills alongside talented engineers. As a Software Development Engineer, you will contribute to the full lifecycle of software—from design and development through testing, deployment, and operations. You will tackle well-defined problems, learn new technologies and design patterns, and collaborate with your team to deliver solutions that create real value for customers. If you are a self-starter who thrives on learning and wants to make a meaningful impact early in your career, this is the role for you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain software components that are high-quality, well-tested, and production-ready, collaborating with your team across the full software development lifecycle.
* Write logical, well-organized code using optimal data structures and algorithms, making thoughtful trade-offs between factors such as maintainability, efficiency, and complexity.
* Participate in code reviews and operational support, helping identify root causes of issues and advocating for improvements to software quality and reliability.
* Leverage generative artificial intelligence tools where appropriate to augment productivity, evaluating and refining outputs to ensure they meet quality standards and responsible practices.
* Collaborate with team members to refactor and improve existing software, contributing to a codebase that is easy for others to understand, extend, and maintain.

  
A day in the life  
You will start your day reviewing code changes from teammates and providing feedback during code reviews. From there, you might pick up a well-scoped feature, break it into components, and begin writing and testing your implementation. You will join standups and design discussions where you can ask questions, share progress, and learn from more experienced engineers. When operational issues arise, you will help troubleshoot and resolve them, building your understanding of the systems your team owns.  
  
About the team  
Our team is focused on building reliable, scalable software that directly improves the customer experience at Amazon. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and writing code we are proud of. You will work alongside engineers who are invested in helping you grow, whether through mentorship, pair programming, or constructive code reviews. We are excited about what lies ahead and are looking for curious, thoughtful engineers who want to grow with us.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Working at Abbott**

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You will also have access to:

  

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit, an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor's degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**About Lingo**

Meet Lingo, a new biosensing technology that provides users a window into their body. Lingo tracks key biomarkers such as glucose, ketones, and lactate to help people make better decisions about their health and nutrition. Biowearable technology will digitize, decentralize and democratize healthcare, enabling consumers to take control of their own health.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

As Staff Platform Engineer at Lingo, you will spend meaningful time building and operating alongside your team, taking ownership of technically complex platform work while also being responsible for the day-to-day allocation of work, tracking and providing feedback to Platform Engineers at the India location. You set the technical standard your team works to, you unblock them when problems are hard, and you make sure they have the clarity, context, and support to do their best work.

Azure is our primary cloud platform. You will bring strong hands-on Azure expertise and apply it across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and SRE practices, while developing your two direct reports to grow in the same disciplines.

**What You'll Work On**

  

* Own the day-to-day work allocation for your team, ensuring engineers have well-scoped, meaningful work that matches their skills and develops their capabilities.
* Support your team through technical challenges, unblocking complex problems and guiding engineers toward solutions rather than solving everything yourself.
* Build, provision, and maintain Lingo's cloud infrastructure on Azure, taking ownership of technically complex or high-risk platform work alongside your team.
* Own and evolve key areas of Lingo's infrastructure-as-code foundation using Terraform or Bicep, including module design, standards, and code review for your team's contributions.
* Design and maintain CI/CD pipeline architecture for Lingo's engineering teams, defining deployment patterns, environment promotion gates, and release automation standards that your team implements and operates.
* Lead from the front on SRE practices, contributing to SLO and SLI definitions, designing alerting and monitoring configurations, and driving post-incident reviews that generate real engineering improvements.
* Build and maintain observability tooling across Lingo's production environment, covering distributed tracing, log pipelines, and metrics collection, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need.
* Partner with product and feature engineering teams to support their deployment needs, onboard them to platform tooling, and reduce friction in the path from development to production.
* Contribute to architecture and design discussions with the Platform Engineer Lead and Senior Manager, providing practical input grounded in your day-to-day operational experience.
* Document infrastructure, runbooks, and operational processes in a way that supports knowledge sharing across Lingo's globally distributed engineering team spanning the US, Spain, and India.
* Identify process, tooling, and reliability improvements within your team's domain and drive them to completion with appropriate prioritization and stakeholder communication.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering with hands-on work in a production environment.
* Strong hands-on Azure expertise, with production experience across Azure compute, networking, storage, identity, and security services.
* Solid infrastructure-as-code skills with Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent, including designing and reviewing reusable modules in a team environment.
* Proven experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent, including deployment automation and environment promotion.
* Working understanding of SRE principles including SLOs, SLIs, alerting strategies, on-call practices, and incident response and post-incident review workflows.
* Experience with observability tooling for monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing in a cloud-native environment.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls including identity and access management, network security configurations, and secrets management.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across a globally distributed engineering team spanning multiple time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Azure-native services such as Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure Security Center in a production context.
* Experience supporting IoT, biosensor, or real-time consumer health data platforms where data reliability and low-latency processing are critical.
* Familiarity with AIOps tooling and AI-driven observability practices, including anomaly detection and automated alerting.
* Background in MLOps infrastructure, including model serving, feature stores, and pipeline orchestration on cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud security and compliance frameworks including HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI in an engineering context.
* Prior experience in a consumer technology company or high-growth digital health environment.

The Engineering Lead oversees the day‑to‑day technical execution of IP discovery, classification, access monitoring, and protection controls. title: Software Development Engineer, Returns and Recommerce
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.  
  
WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill “the 3 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world.  
Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.  
  
As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.  
  
We are looking for software engineers with 4+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.  
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.  
  
Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WW R&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience  
2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience  
Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 4+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

description:
**About the Role:**

11

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Application & Cloud Security Lead will serve as a key security leader within the S&P Global Energy Division BISO team, responsible for coordinating security initiatives across application, cloud, and AI-enabled environments. This role directly supports the protection of applications, data, systems, and reputation by proactively managing cyber risk, strengthening resilience and embedding security into everything we do.

The successful candidate will partner with technology, product, engineering, cloud, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into architecture, delivery, operations, and innovation. The role will focus on security architecture reviews, application security governance, cloud security enforcement, AI security oversight, risk remediation, and alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards.

This position requires a hands-on security leader who can translate cybersecurity requirements into practical controls, influence engineering teams, guide secure design decisions, and drive measurable improvements in cyber resilience across the Energy Division.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and coordinate application, cloud, and AI security initiatives across the S&P Global Energy Division in alignment with S&P Global's cyber risk management objectives.

* Oversee cloud security control implementation across public cloud environments, including identity and access management, network security, encryption, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration.
* Review and assess AI and machine learning use cases for security risks, including data leakage, prompt injection, model exposure, access control, third-party AI risk, and misuse scenarios.
* Track, prioritize, and drive remediation of application, cloud, and AI security findings, exceptions, and risk acceptances in partnership with accountable technology owners.

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

title: Software Engineering Manager -Big Data Engineering Manager
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a **Software Engineering Manager** to lead a team of **engineers** building and operating **mission‑critical Risk and Finance data platforms**.

This role blends **software engineering leadership**, **data engineering** and **SRE practices**, with accountability for **platform reliability, data correctness, and operational excellence**. You will work closely with Risk, Finance, Infrastructure, and Platform teams operating with a strong **sense of urgency** in a highly regulated environment.

**In this role, you will:**

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of individual contributor engineer roles with low to moderate complexity and less experienced managers who are responsible for building high quality capabilities with modern technology
* Engage with architects and experienced engineers to incorporate Wells Fargo Technology technical strategies, while understanding next generation domain architecture to enable application migration paths to target architecture; for example, cloud readiness, application modernization and data strategy
* Function as the technical representative for the product during cross-team collaborative efforts and planning
* Identify and recommend opportunities for driving resolution of technology roadblocks including code, build and deployment while also managing overall software development cycle and security standards
* Act as an escalation partner for scrum masters and the teams to make decisions and help remove impediments, obstacles, and friction while encouraging constant learning, experimentation, and continual improvement culture
* Build engineering skills side-by-side in the codebase, conduct peer reviews to evaluate quality and solution alignment to technical direction, and guide design, as needed
* Interpret, develop, and ensure security, stability, and scalability within functions of technology with low to moderate complexity, as well as identify, manage and mitigate technology and enterprise risk
* Collaborate and consult with the Product Managers/Product Owners to drive user satisfaction, influence technology requirements and priorities in the product roadmap, promote innovative and intelligent solutions, generate corporate value and articulate technical strategy while being a solid advocate of agile and DevOps practices
* Interact directly with third party vendors and technology service providers
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for technology engineering including career development and performance management for engineers and managers on the team
* Hire, mentor and guide talent development of direct reports to build the skills required to effectively design and deliver innovative solutions for the supported product areas/products

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 2+ years of Leadership experience

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Big Data & Storage: Apache Iceberg, Hive, Big Data platforms
* Processing & Streaming: Spark, Kafka
* Platforms: Data Private Cloud, NexusOne Intelligence
* Cloud & Infra: Private Cloud / Hybrid Cloud environments
* Practices: CI/CD, observability, automation, incident management

**Job Expectations:**

* Lead engineers delivering **production-grade data platforms** for Risk, Finance, and Regulatory reporting.
* Own **reliability, availability, performance, and recoverability** of data platforms.
* Apply **SRE principles**: Observability, automation and tooling.
* Partner closely with **Risk and Finance stakeholders** to deliver accurate, reconciled, auditable data under strict deadlines.
* Collaborate daily with **Data Platform, Private Cloud, Infrastructure and platform teams**.
* Drive **fast, high‑quality execution** while balancing delivery, stability, and regulatory risk.
* Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Act with urgency to unblock teams, resolve issues, and keep critical platforms stable.

**Posting End Date:**

15 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

title: Data Engineer II, Infra-Finance Business intelligence & Transformations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you have a desire to make a major contribution to the future in the rapid growth environment of Cloud Computing? Are you passionate about data and code? Does the prospect of dealing with massive volumes of data excite you? Do you want to build data engineering solutions that process millions of records?
  
  
Amazon Web Services is looking for a Data Engineer to help build a scalable, secured and robust data infrastructure that supports the AWS supply chain Finance (SCF) organization. You will be part of the SCF Analytics team working with other Data Engineers, Business Intelligence engineers, Product managers and partner with finance/business stakeholders to achieve our goals.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, implement, and support large-scale data pipelines and ETL processes using AWS technologies
* Lead and design complex data architectures, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with business objectives.
* Build and maintain efficient, scalable data pipelines and curated datasets optimized for AI consumption and self service analytics.
* Identify and resolve system-wide data challenges, including performance bottlenecks and architectural deficiencies.
* Tune application and query performance using profiling tools and SQL.
* Analyze and solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context.
* Keep up to date with advances in data technologies and run pilots to design the data architecture to scale with the increased data volume using AWS.
* Continually improve ongoing reporting and analysis processes, automating or simplifying self-service support for datasets.
* Triage many possible courses of action in a high-ambiguity environment, making use of both quantitative analysis and business judgment.
* Recognize and adopt best practices: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation.
* Ensure data solutions are auditable, accessible, and maintainable across the organization
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative data solutions

  
About the team  
IFBIT team vision is to simplify and automate processes, drive data-led decision making and provide meaningful insights for enhanced financial and business performance. We aim to cultivate a culture of innovation and collaboration, build and evangelize data analytics capabilities, develop scalable products that reduce manual efforts, improve efficiency and enhance controllership. By doing this, we contribute to improving AWS financial performance in a sustainable manner. Our focus on scalability, agility, and customer-centric products also aligns with the goal of maximizing long-term value for our customers and the company.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of data engineering experience
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* 5+ years of SQL experience
* Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
* Experience as a data engineer or related specialty (e.g., software engineer, business intelligence engineer, data scientist) with a track record of manipulating, processing, and extracting value from large datasets
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
* Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)
* Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence
* Experience building/operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Principal Applied Scientist
description:
**Overview**

**Overview**

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) underpins Microsoft’s global cloud infrastructure, driving the innovation, planning, design, construction, and operation of one of the largest data center fleets in the world. We are seeking an exceptional **Principal Applied Scientist** to join the **Data Center Applied AI** team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in advancing and integrating **cutting‑edge, multimodal agentic AI systems** into core tools and operational workflows that power Microsoft’s data centers. Your work will drive operational efficiency at scale and help advance Microsoft’s mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more through intelligent, multimodal AI agents.

As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will **bridge state‑of‑the‑art AI research with production‑grade engineering**, delivering agent architectures that are **reliable, secure, scalable, observable, and measurable**. You will collaborate closely with Business and Engineering to build and deploy agentic capabilities across workflow automation, information retrieval, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), tool and function calling, long‑horizon task execution, and multi‑agent orchestration.

This role blends deep AI and applied science expertise with strong engineering judgment, operational rigor, and a bias for action. Success requires end‑to‑end ownership, a growth mindset, and strong customer empathy. Join us to shape the future of agentic AI for data center operations at global scale.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We work with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals—guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 **Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Advance Applied AI Research to Improve Quality and Reliability**
  + Apply deep expertise in **Generative AI, deep learning, NLP, and multimodal models** to translate cutting-edge research into **high-impact, production-ready AI solutions**.
  + Design and execute experiments that measurably improve **agent planning, memory, grounding, reasoning, and long‑horizon task completion**.
  + Perform **lightweight fine‑tuning** (e.g., LoRA and related techniques) on multimodal and large multimodal language models—to improve entity recognition, reasoning accuracy, and response quality.
  + Implement state‑of‑the‑art approaches using **foundation models, advanced prompt engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and multi‑agent architectures**, complemented by classical ML techniques where appropriate.
* **Build and Ship Scalable Agentic AI Systems**
  + Architect and implement **end‑to‑end agent workflows** that decompose user intent into executable plans, intelligently select and invoke tools, and recover gracefully from errors and edge cases.
  + Rapidly prototype solutions and partner with engineering teams to drive **production deployment**, including debugging live systems and building **AIOps workflows**.

  + Drive production excellence across **latency, reliability, cost efficiency, observability, monitoring, and safe fallback behaviors**.
* **Own Evaluation, Metrics, and Iteration Loops**

  + Build and maintain **offline and online evaluation pipelines**, including:
    - Golden datasets, scenario simulators, and regression test suites
    - Human‑in‑the‑loop evaluation frameworks and rubric design

  + Partner with business and engineering stakeholders to translate requirements into **clear technical specifications, research plans, and delivery milestones**.

  + Mentor and support other applied scientists and engineers, raising the bar for **applied AI execution and production quality**

* **10+ years** of hands‑on experience applying NLP, and/or LLMs to **real‑world production problems**.
* Strong foundation in **Large Language Models (LLMs)**, Generative AI, deep learning, and modern NLP.
* Proven experience building **production‑grade LLM systems**, including prompt engineering, RAG, and multi‑step reasoning pipelines.
* Solid expertise in **chunking strategies and embedding selection**, including tradeoffs in retrieval quality, context size, and downstream task performance.
* Experience designing and operating **vector databases**, including indexing strategies, similarity metrics, and retrieval optimization.
* Experience supporting **production operations (AIOps/MLOps)**, including monitoring, logging, quality metrics, and debugging live systems.

* Strong applied experimentation skills: defining metrics, analyzing results, and iterating based on data.

title: Systems Development Engineer II, FO Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide — faster and cheaper each day — while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network, and an expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business with best-in-class technology innovations.  
  
We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications — and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.  
  
As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Dive deeply into technical details to diagnose, reproduce, and root-cause issues across Amazon technology products (services, tools, data solutions, etc.), and drive them to resolution or escalation.
* Design, build, and operate AI-powered and agentic support capabilities — diagnostic agents, automated root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and self-healing/auto-remediation — that detect and prevent issues before they impact customers.
* Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (spec-driven and AI-assisted development, agentic workflows) to raise engineering velocity and quality.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase efficiency and reduce manual toil, and build tooling that enables other engineers.
* Manage trouble tickets through to resolution or escalation using existing documentation, procedures, and tools, and improve those mechanisms over time.
* Use technology to monitor security vulnerabilities and eliminate risk; identify and mitigate reliability risks at the team and component level.
* Improve service resilience, performance, and operational metrics; define and apply operational-excellence practices for the team.
* Participate in a team on-call rotation, providing operational support for the services the team owns.
* Collaborate with partner teams, Technical Program Managers, and Product Managers to deliver on shared goals.
* Work in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology.

  
About the team  
The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment.  
  
The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies — including AI and agentic automation — to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. The team is responsible for FO services as front-line support and plays a central role in the organization's success.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building services using AWS products
* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming
* Experience building or integrating AI/GenAI-powered solutions (e.g., LLM-based tools, agentic frameworks, automated diagnostics or remediation)
* Ability to work independently and solve problems using knowledge of an object-oriented programming language

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you looking for an opportunity to build a highly available, large scale, enterprise-wide software solution? Does it excite you to find patterns and build generic, composable software solutions to solve complex problems? Are you looking for inventing newer and simpler ways of building solutions? If so, we are looking for you to fill a challenging position in Amazon Finance Automation Payroll Technology team.  
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE II on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.  
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g., significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g., performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.) You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You re-use where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)  
This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned engineer. In this position, you will play a leading role in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex financial applications.
